exposure: Views and experiences of Vietnamese health professionals on maternal and fetal health interests
outcome: Agreement on the fetus as a person from conception
Prioritization of maternal health interests over fetal health interests
Agreement on the fetus never being a patient
Perceived weight given to fetal health interests with advancing gestation
cohort: The cohort consisted of 882 Vietnamese health professionals, including obstetricians/gynecologists, midwives, and sonographers, who manage pregnant women in maternity wards in the Hanoi region.
finding: A significant proportion of Vietnamese health professionals consider the fetus a person whose personhood evolves during pregnancy and often a patient with its own health interests, while still prioritizing maternal health interests; those who perform ultrasounds are more likely to perceive fetal health interests gaining more weight with advancing gestation.
